Community Care Archive · Paratactic Beside-ness

Sovereign Reading Stream

In her foundational essay on reparative reading, Eve Kosofsky Sedgwick proposes that to read reparatively is to surrender the paranoid imperative of exposure. It asks what beside-ness might accomplish when hierarchy, suspicion, and procedural retribution are set aside in favor of care.

Beside-ness refuses vertical subordination. The marginal note is neither a humble subservient footnote nor a sovereign decree; it sits alongside the text, sharing proximity without absorbing or crushing what came before.

Heritage Covenant: Khona‌lit-po — Preserving U+200C non-joiner boundary and non-retroactivity in communal custody.
